name: Misa
message: 「It's a mystery to me how Sally can say that with such confidence.」

name: Synn
message: 「Was there some issue with the paperwork?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh. Me? Is something wrong with the accounting documents?」

name: Helena
message: 「Close! They are documents, yes, and they deal with numbers too, though of a slightly different nature.」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't tell me you haven't done anything at all!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-wait a second! I left it back in the classroom!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yes, that's the bag! Wait, why is it here!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Because I brought it with me, obviously.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A-Ah, um, let's see, I-I-I-I remembered! I-In my locker!」

name: Helena
message: 「Your homework is at your house, isn't it, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yes, yes, it is! Wait, how do you know that?!」

name: Helena
message: 「Because I attached a small transmitter just in case something like this happened.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Rather than walls having ears, cleaning has eyes, it seems.」

name: Synn
message: 「Planting a transmitter is awful! Even if you're the chairwoman, there's a line between what's okay and what's not!」

name: Helena
message: 「And is not doing your homework something that's okay, I wonder?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka's busy helping out at her family's restaurant, Yuugiri-an! It's the end of the year, after all!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Yes, that's right! L-Lately I've been so busy helping out at home after getting back! It's enough to make my head spin!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Treasurer-san. If your head spins, you will collapse and be unable to stay busy.」

name: Helena
message: 「So you've been busy. I see, well, that can't be helped then.」

name: Helena
message: 「I understand completely. I'll let you off the hook today.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I suppose this is what they call tears in a demon's eyes.」

name: Helena
message: 「Lolotte, you're coming to the chairwoman's office later.」

name: Helena
message: 「Nanaka, starting today, I'll have you work on it for one hour every day.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Assuming I'm not busy helping out, anyway. Like I'd ever have the time.」

name: Synn
message: 「...I'll help Nanaka study! Just giving hints wouldn't be a problem, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「True, Synn-kun would be the right person for the job.」

name: Misa
message: 「But... isn't it inappropriate for a boy and a girl to be all alone together late in the afternoon?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What are you saying, Misa! You know way too much for your own good!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's not like anything would happen between me and Nanaka just because we're alone.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Yeah! There's no way anything would happen! So much nothing that it's practically a problem!」

name: Helena
message: 「Because I trust Nanaka-chan, I've already arranged a chaperone on our end.」

name: Ria
message: 「...Big Sis, the two halves of that 'because' sentence don't connect at all.」

name: Helena
message: 「Her, right here. When I explained the situation, she accepted without a second thought, so we can't very well turn her down now, can we.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I've got a bad feeling about this.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I am Akane Misasagi, your chaperone, dosu.」

name: Helena
message: 「Starting today, you'll be dedicating one hour after meals to your assignments--I've already gotten permission from Nanaka-chan's parents.」

name: Helena
message: 「By the way, the transmitter was a lie.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「So, I'll be in your care for a little while.」
